sales_notes: Background: SignalStride builds an in-app product recommendation engine + conversational product assistant for mid-market ecommerce customers.
Ask: Start on Hosted API to validate UX; move to Dedicated for cost predictability once usage grows (targeting 8-12M tokens/day peak within 6 months).
POC outcome: Hosted API POC exceeded recall goals; main concern now is unit economics at scale and data isolation for enterprise clients.
Pricing discussion: customer wants a 12-month committed Dedicated plan. Proposed config: 4x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs initially, scale-to-8 after month 3 (ramp schedule).
Burst: they want 2x burst for short promotions (black Friday-style spikes). Proposed approach: burst pool with soft limit and automated billing for true overage.

Overage: legal pushback — want a capped overage monthly spend (e.g., no more than 25% over committed spend) or a stepped overage rate. Sales proposing tiered overage: negotiated rate up to 125% usage, premium rate above that.
Ramp schedule: Month 0-3: 4 GPUs commit; Month 4-6: scale to 8 GPUs; optional review at month 6 to rebase commit.
Commercial ask: prefer monthly invoicing, but open to quarterly for a small discount. Interested in a 10-12% discount for 12-month commit + 6-month ramp guardrails.
Key quote: CTO said, 'We need predictable bills or we won't be able to sell to our enterprise pilots.'
Next internal risks: procurement wants a clause tying latency SLOs to credits — engineering wants clear SLO definitions and telemetry access (per-route dashboards).
performance_requirements: Chat latency target: p95 <= 150ms (goal 120ms) for standard user flows
Reranking/embeddings throughput: steady 50 req/s with short spikes up to 200 req/s for promotions
Monthly volumetrics (est): 500M tokens/month initial; scale to ~1.2B tokens/month by month 6
Model preference: open models (LLaMA family/Redwood-verified) for licensing; interested in quantized variants for cost savings
